CRLR No. 444 of 2018 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. M.S. Pal, Senior Advocate assisted 
by Mr. Suraj Pandey, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
Mr. Sachin Panwar, Brief Holder for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to the private respondent no. 
2. 
Steps may be taken within a week. 
Summon the lower court record. 
List thereafter. 
The revisionist would be released on bail 
subject to the condition that he will furnish 
personal bond as well as two sureties of the like 
amount to the satisfaction of the Magistrate and 
also with the condition that he will be released 
on bail subject to deposit of the entire penalty 
amount of `4,25,000/- as levied against him 
within a period of six weeks from the date of 
receipt of certified copy of the order. 
 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 02.01.2019 
Pooja
